summary: A message someone deletes or unsends is hidden from Nora and nothing more: the cascade of notes, events and positions that marked what cited it is gone, and so are `nora person forget`, the held-delete table and the cognition health command and alerts.
details: A delete or unsend of a recorded message hides it (it is not shown, replayed or fed to memory again). A delete of a message Nora has no record of is dropped.
Removed because the harm they guarded never happened: 2 deletes in 5,984 messages, no held delete ever, and Honcho keeps what it was fed regardless.

Removed: `nora person forget` / `unforget`, `nora withdrawal reconcile-deletes`, `nora cognition health`, the alerts NoraRestartLoop, NoraErrorsRising, CognitionWakeStalled, StimulusBacklog, CognitionSessionsFailing, OrphanDeleteLost and OrphanDeleteEvicted, the `orphan_delete` table (migration 0092) and the Assess check `unresolved_citations`.
Kept: the SIGTERM handler and the reclaim of sessions a restart left open.

Also removed, nothing read or marked them any more: the `unsupported_at` columns on notes, events, Standing and culture, the `citation` edge table, the held-gathering-reminder screen, `render_supported`, the documents forgotten read side and the token columns on `cognition_wake_outcome` (migration 0093; the token counter metric stays).
limitations: Rows already marked unsupported come back into her context when migration 0093 drops the mark; nothing had set one since the cascade went.
A delete from someone other than the author is refused only on Signal; on WhatsApp a forged revoke hides the message.
